title: First sheet music and lessons at seven
summary: My Gal Sal was her first sheet music as a child. She started lessons at seven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What were some of the earliest piano copies, you know, sheet music for piano that you ever played?
My Gal Sal was one. That was my first piece of sheet music that I ever attempted as a child.
Any others you remember from back then?
That's the only one I was really interested in, because I was so happy that I could play.
Did you play by ear before you took any lessons? No. Always... you started off with music but could always...
Yeah, seven years old. I started my first lesson.
